value.rationale: The theorem answers a motivated connectivity restoration problem with both fragile intermediate sites and multiple investable links. It gives a nontrivial discontinuous concentration-to-diversification threshold, exact optimizer/tie classification, and a sharp contrast showing one-edge parallel backups cannot exhibit the same behavior under the same cost and viability laws. This is a structural benchmark rather than field guidance.
